text: Every lesson card is a step. There is no separate "part": what the pagination docs call a part is a step, the step list and "Step N of M" count cards, and the character ceilings (833 / 784 / 735) apply to each step. Supersedes ui.lesson.card.step-means-screen-2026-10-05 where it keeps "part" as a separate term.
rationale: Owner: every card is a step
